seo.description: Listening comprehension test for intermediate students (CEFR B1). Watch a video about travel and choose the correct answers.

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Watch a video about an underground city in Turkey, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

For more videos like this, go to Great Big Story
Questions

questions.prompt: The system of tunnels and caves in the Cappadocia region was first discovered 1,000 years ago.
The hidden city of Derinkuyu has 18 floors underground.
The city was discovered by some explorers examining an excavation.
The city was created during the Byzantine era to be the home of the people in the area.
They had animals and schools in this city.
